text:
ellie (AE): Quick ask from Globex POC — they want: short-lived hosted API keys for 6 engineers, a sandbox VPC endpoint for Private trial, and least-privileged workspace invites (4 infra engineers, 2 product). They also want separation of billing for the POC and confirmation on key rotation policy for their security questionnaire.

rajan (Solutions): For hosted keys we can mint scoped tokens with TTL (recommended 8-24h for devs). For CI/service usage we can provide short-lived service accounts with automated rotation. For Private/VPC trial we can stand up a dedicated-private endpoint in a new workspace but need their VPC peering details + allowed CIDR.

nina (Sales-Eng): Pricing note: sandbox Private trials need infra approval; we can cover infra credits for up to 10 days. Dedicated private pools are more involved. For billing separation we can create a project-level billing tag so usage appears separately on invoices.

harper (Security): RBAC suggestion: create two workspace groups: poc-engineer (can call inference, create ephemeral keys tied to SSO), poc-audit (read-only + logs). Do NOT grant poc-engineer pool-admin. Also provide the questionnaire language: "Ephemeral keys are TTL-based, revocable centrally, and can be bound to SSO/SCIM for automated deprovisioning."

ellie (AE): Can we bind keys to Okta SCIM so removing a user auto-revokes active tokens? Globex uses Okta.

rajan (Solutions): Yes. We'll need Okta SCIM config and a service account. We can also set up group sync so team membership maps to our workspace roles.

otto (Infra): Opening infra request for sandbox private endpoint and 1xA10g dedicated trial (for latency comparison). provision-bot: create INFRA ticket for Globex POC.

provision-bot: Ticket created: #INFRA-8299 Requested: private-sandbox endpoint + 1xA10g for 10 days. Priority: P1. Estimated approval window: 24-48h.

nina (Sales-Eng): I'll note the 10-day funded credit and share the billing tag instructions with Globex.

harper (Security): For the questionnaire I'll prepare a one-page snippet including: key rotation details, SCIM integration steps, audit log retention (90 days), and encryption at rest notes. I won't sign anything that asks for extended retention unless Legal approves.

ellie (AE): Perfect. Action list: 1) otto follow INFRA-8299 and post updates here; 2) rajan to provide Okta SCIM checklist + example role-mapping YAML; 3) nina to send billing tag and 10-day credit note; 4) harper to draft questionnaire snippet. I'll coordinate handoff to Globex once we have Okta metadata and ticket ID.

rajan (Solutions): Example role-mapping YAML (small snippet):

```
- group: poc-engineer
  grants:
    - inference:invoke
    - keys:create:ephemeral
- group: poc-audit
  grants:
    - console:read
    - logs:view
```

ellie (AE): thanks team — will update Globex. :rocket:
